name: mirage
text: Yes. v1.0.24 is out: https://github.com/tjshea90/novig/releases/tag/v1.0.24 . It has #3: ESPN's win probability now cross-checks the live model (a live moneyline bet is held back when ESPN rates it 25+ points less likely than the model; it never prices a bet). #1 I measured and am NOT using: the CDN scoreboard is cached 101 s against 4 s for the ESPN call the app already uses, so it is staler, and a stale score would put wrong live bets in. #2 (ESPN odds as a never-called-unless-needed backup) is next: it touches the API switches and scan chain, so I am building it carefully to leave the Novig scan untouched (CH46b).
